youtube_sessions.title: 🎬 YouTube Session Management
youtube_sessions.upload_prompt: Send the Netscape cookie file as a .txt Document. ⚠️ Do not paste cookie contents into chat. Send cancel to stop.
youtube_sessions.upload_delete_warning: ⚠️ The cookie file was processed, but Telegram did not allow deleting its message. Delete it manually.
youtube_sessions.upload_success: ✅ Session YT-{session_id} was saved and activated.
youtube_sessions.upload_test_failed: ⚠️ Session YT-{session_id} was saved but its test failed. Test it again from the session list.
youtube_sessions.error_file_too_large: ⚠️ The cookie file is too large.
youtube_sessions.error_invalid_encoding: ⚠️ The cookie file must use UTF-8 encoding.
youtube_sessions.error_invalid_netscape_header: ⚠️ This is not a valid Netscape Cookie File.
youtube_sessions.error_no_youtube_cookie_rows: ⚠️ No valid YouTube or Google cookies were found.
youtube_sessions.error_key_missing: ⚠️ The YouTube-session security key is not configured on the server.
youtube_sessions.error_generic: ❌ The session could not be processed. Try again.
youtube_sessions.list_empty: ⚠️ No sessions have been registered yet.
youtube_sessions.detail: YT-{session_id} Status: {status} Last test: {checked} Last selected: {selected} Last success: {success} Tracked expiry: {expires} Last error: {error}
youtube_sessions.enable_invalid: ⚠️ This session is invalid; test it first.
youtube_sessions.delete_prompt: ⚠️ Delete session YT-{session_id}? This cannot be undone.
youtube_sessions.delete_wrong_user: ⛔ This confirmation belongs to another user.
youtube_sessions.rekey_prompt: ⚠️ Re-encrypt every YouTube session with the current key? Do not remove YOUTUBE_COOKIE_KEY_OLD until the operation completes successfully.
youtube_sessions.rekey_not_ready: ⚠️ Rekey requires distinct, valid current and old server keys.
youtube_sessions.rekey_busy: ⏳ Another rekey operation is already running.
youtube_sessions.rekey_expired: ⏱ This rekey confirmation expired or was already used.
youtube_sessions.rekey_wrong_user: ⛔ This confirmation belongs to another user.
youtube_sessions.rekey_success: ✅ Rekey completed: {succeeded} sessions. You may now remove YOUTUBE_COOKIE_KEY_OLD from config and restart the bot.
youtube_sessions.rekey_partial: ⚠️ Rekey is incomplete: {succeeded} succeeded and {failed} failed. Do not remove YOUTUBE_COOKIE_KEY_OLD.
youtube_sessions.watchdog_unavailable: ⚠️ YouTube session pool is unavailable: active {active}, cooling down {cooldown}, disabled/invalid {inactive}.
youtube_sessions.watchdog_recovered: ✅ The YouTube session pool is available again.
youtube_sessions.not_found: ⚠️ Session was not found or has been deleted.
youtube_sessions.unavailable: ⚠️ No YouTube session is available. Try again shortly.
youtube_sessions.playlist_requires_video: ⚠️ For a playlist, send a link to a specific video.
youtube_sessions.download_expired: ⏱ This download choice expired. Send the download command again.
